entities.name: Bayul
entities.description: Blind loxodon Living Saint of the Selesnya Conclave who traveled to spread its word.

entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: Ledev guardian responsible for protecting Bayul.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Schemed the assassination attempt on Bayul.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Schemed the assassination attempt on Bayul.

entities.name: Kel
entities.description: Loxodon who inherited Bayul's seat as Living Saint.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Ravnican celebration before which Bayul returned.

events.summary: Bayul is targeted by an assassination attempt by a suicidal Rakdos goblin schemed by Savra and Szadek, and survives in a hibernation state.
events.quote: Bayul became a target of an assassination attempt

events.summary: Bayul instructs Fonn on how to stop Savra's plans and then passes away.
events.quote: Bayul instructed Fonn on how to stop Savra's plans during the Decamillennial

events.summary: Kel inherits Bayul's seat as Living Saint.
events.quote: His seat as Living Saint passed on to the loxodon Kel after Bayul's death.

relations.quote: Saint Bayul was a loxodon and a member of the Selesnya Conclave
